slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked when purchases occur within the month or whether purchased units are available for sale in the same month. The READY_TO_MODEL model silently assumes same-month availability.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of the month or are otherwise available for sale in the same month, as reflected by the inventory balance I_t = I_{t-1} + P_t - S_t and the statement that purchases and sales occur within the month.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask about purchase timing, and the user did not confirm that purchased units can be sold in the same month.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 purchase-timing hidden slot remained unresolved and silently assumed same-month availability.

summary: The agent clarified several secondary details, but failed to ask the key timing question about whether purchases are made at the beginning of each month and available for same-month sale, then stopped with that P1 fact unconfirmed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
